paper_title: Vector Wave Dark Matter and Terrestrial Quantum Sensors
notes: Framework/projection paper. Section 3.2 ('Projected Exclusions') derives 90% CL limits from Monte Carlo background-only pseudodata for hypothetical experiments; Fig. 5 shows projected 90% CL limits on g_B-L for a proposed optomechanical cavity setup at three benchmark resonance frequencies (f0 = 0.1, 1, 10 Hz). No real experimental data is analyzed. The Eot-Wash and MICROSCOPE curves in Fig. 5 (and the epsilon_B-L recast in Appendix E) are reinterpretations of other experiments' published results, shown for comparison, not a new measured limit. Hence is_projection = true with no data points.
